purpose: Record the C6 subset-size audit before changing the selection rule.
packageRequirement: The S2-derived Android subset should be in the hundreds; it must not be silently shrunk to fit a batch budget.

previousRule.remainingSelection: one deterministic greedy set-cover pass over operations, positions, states, and race phases
previousRule.knownLimitation: The minimum set-cover result satisfies the six coverage rules but is below the package's stated hundreds-scale expectation.

decision: Do not use either 98-case manifest as final C6 acceptance evidence. The rule was widened only after this pre-change record, and the widened manifests were generated and hashed below.

hardInclusions: all C5 single_operation cases (the finite operation × declared topology-position representative matrix)
postChangeRule.remainingSelection: deterministic greedy set-cover only for dimensions not already covered by hard inclusions
postChangeRule.finitePolicy: Do not include ordered_pair, boundary_topology, state_interruption, or three_way layers in full; add only witnesses needed for uncovered state/race-phase values.
